items.headline: World Bank Forecasts 23 Percent Jump in Global Commodity Prices Due to Energy and Food Shocks
items.summary: The World Bank released its latest Commodity Markets Outlook report warning that global commodity prices could surge by 23 percent in 2026. Heightened Middle East conflicts driving oil prices to four-year highs alongside severe weather disruptions threaten to push up food and energy costs worldwide.

items.headline: NASA Assembles SLS Core Stage for Artemis III Lunar Mission
items.summary: On October 28, 2026, NASA engineers at Kennedy Space Center successfully stacked the 212-foot core stage of the Space Launch System rocket between its twin solid rocket boosters inside the Vehicle Assembly Building. This major hardware integration marks a key step forward as the agency prepares for the Artemis III mission to return humans to the Moon.

items.headline: Rays Stun Brewers with 12th-Inning Walk-Off Rally to Force World Series Game 5
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays kept their season alive with a dramatic 4-3 walk-off victory in 12 innings against the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 4 of the World Series. Facing elimination down three games to none, Tampa Bay capitalized on a late fielding error and consecutive hits to prevent a championship sweep and force Game 5.

items.headline: Kathleen Kennedy Appointed to Lead Ceremonies for LA 2028 Olympics
items.summary: Veteran film producer Kathleen Kennedy has been named head of ceremonies and content for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic and Paralympic Games. The former Lucasfilm chief will direct the creative vision for the opening and closing events, stepping into the role after Peter Rice departed for Netflix.
